skills.name: imagegen

skills.name: mvp-scope

skills.name: openai-docs

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Use for pull-request, branch-diff, or proposed-merge review, including merge-risk scoring and structured GitHub review output. Do not use for a generic delegated or read-only code-change review; use review-agent instead.

skills.name: product-discovery
skills.description: Use first when the product problem, target user, or desired outcome is still vague; produce an evidence-backed problem statement, assumptions, and validation plan. Do not use for fixed scope decisions or an implementable feature specification; use mvp-scope or product-spec.
skills.primary_trigger: Use first when the product problem, user, or outcome is still unclear.

skills.name: product-spec
skills.description: Use after product intent is sufficiently understood to write an implementable feature specification covering behavior, requirements, edge cases, permissions, analytics, and acceptance criteria. Do not use to clarify a vague problem or reduce scope; use product-discovery or mvp-scope.

skills.name: read-the-damn-docs

skills.name: review-agent

skills.primary_trigger: Request review of uncommitted changes, a base diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

skills.name: security-best-practices
